posts.trend: 250+ job applications, zero callbacks: IIM Kozhikode MBA grad asks if anyone is hiring
posts.context: Indian parents struggle to comprehend a services economy that does not reward traditional academic linear progress.
posts.angle: The older generation's belief in institutional brand names is entirely incompatible with modern algorithmic hiring.
slides: Explain the job market to your father today.

"IIM se padha hai na?"

"Toh naukri kyun nahi mil rahi?"

"Tumhari generation ko sab jaldi chahiye."

"Thoda adjust kar lo."

He still thinks the dean calls companies for placements.

Log kya kahenge.
posts.caption: The syllabus changed. Nobody sent him the PDF. 📚
posts.rank_verdict: Ending on 'Log kya kahenge' ruins both the voice and the global travel of an otherwise sharp observation.
